could_not_change_the_connection_check_th: Could not change the connection. Check the profile and diagnostic log.
could_not_save_routing_try_again_in_rout: Could not save routing. Try again in Routing settings.
could_not_save_this_setting_check_the_ad: Could not save this setting. Check the AdBlock / WARP settings.
routing_was_saved_but_could_not_be_appli: Routing was saved, but could not be applied. Check the connection status and Routing settings.
the_setting_was_saved_but_could_not_be_a: The setting was saved, but could not be applied. Check the connection status and AdBlock / WARP settings.
tray_allow_lan: Allow connections from the local network
tray_remember_last_server: Connect to the last server on startup
tray_setting_failed: Could not change this setting. Open Settings to see the reason.
tray_setting_reconnect_failed: The setting was changed, but the connection could not be restored. Connect again from the main window.
windows_session_end_reason: Restoring network settings before the session ends
windows_qr_consent: Thronium will take one picture of every screen to find a QR code. The picture is not saved or sent anywhere.
windows_qt_throne_running: Qt Throne is running. If its system proxy, TUN or system DNS is on, it and Thronium will disturb each other; switch them off in Throne first.
notification_connection_lost_body: {name} stopped working. Open Thronium to see why.
notification_subscriptions_changed_body: Profiles changed. Open Thronium to see the results.
